credential.kind: TokenRequest short-lived ServiceAccount credential; no persistent token Secret
credential.issuer: Must capture actual isolated cluster issuer at authorized issuance, not infer or accept arbitrary token issuer
credential.audience: One explicit audience accepted by isolated API server; capture at issuance
credential.boundTo: Exact SA namespace/name/UID; no Pod is required for Docker executor and no invented Pod-binding claim
credential.provisioner: Existing isolated test manager only, after same approved guard ADMIN_VALIDATION identity check; no production credential, no grant to executor to mint/refresh tokens
credential.injection: Owned 0600 single-context dedicated kubeconfig with embedded CA+token, private file only; no shell arg/env token/tokenFile/exec auth plugin. Guard snapshot 0400 in clean scope, no admin config mount
credential.renewal: No automatic refresh/fallback. On expiry fail closed, stop and require separately recorded test credential issuance

clusterRoleReason: Pinned cluster namespace UID + executor namespace UID + authenticated identity proof are cluster-scoped; no business Secret access in this role

selfAccessReview.reason: kubectl auth can-i requires selfsubjectaccessreviews. Rely on existing verified isolated system:basic-user during future preflight; if unavailable stop. Do not silently create another role or alter bootstrap bindings.

discovery: Existing isolated system:discovery binding must be verified during future preflight; no new wildcard Role and no changed kubectl validation flags
guardProof: config path+SHA pinned trusted issuance snapshot
only static JWT token auth allowed in min profile
offline sub/issuer/audience/expiry/SA UID checks (not signature claim)
real API SelfSubjectReview proves signature-authenticated username, UID and exact groups
real API kube-system and executor namespace UID match
TLS CA/server pins and no connection override
certificate/admin config rejected by min profile before API
admin profile cannot execute protected child
adminExcluded: No token mint/read of admin key in final executor, no cluster-admin grant, no fallback. Provisioning management and Gate execution are different roles, both require the same guard boundary. Future fixture manager must integrate with it; not a second Kubernetes entry.

inventoryAmendment.mutator: Use separately scoped test manager for fixture mutations, never lend management credentials to Gate child
inventoryAmendment.explanation: Supersedes previous executor/mutator certificate-user proposal. Mutation roles bind to existing isolated fixture manager only as needed; gate executor is short-lived SA-bound. No such resources are created now.
